newsitem.title: CHINA: Seven migrants die in midnight fire in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Seven migrants die in midnight fire in Shanghai.

text.p: Seven migrant workers died in their sleep when their cramped quarters at a Shanghai bakery caught fire in the early hours of Monday morning, Liberation Daily said on Tuesday.

The seven, including the bakery boss from southern Fujian province, choked to death on smoke when the 10 square metres (120 sq ft) room they were illegally using as living quarters caught fire about 2.00 a.m. (1800 GMT), the newspaper said.
It said the fire at the bakery in Shanghai's Pudong economic development zone was caused by misuse of gas, but gave no futher detail other than to say it was being investigated.
China's economic reforms have seen millions of peasants leave the land in recent years to flood into urban centres in search of work.
Once there, they take whatever jobs they can find, while lack of accommodation often forces them to live in squalid and cramped conditions where they work.
